correctness.rationale: The quaternionic 48-point list and antipodal quotient give 24 points and S4; exact Chebyshev values U12(1)=13, U12(0)=U12(1/2)=1 and U12(1/sqrt2)=-1 give B=12I+J-2A. The S4 irreducible character table diagonalizes the six-4-cycle Cayley sum, establishing eigenvalues 24 twice, 12 fourfold, 8 and 16 ninefold each. Fourier inversion gives diagonal inverse 101/1152 and offdiagonal class numerators -4,-7,+9,-9. Jacobi complementary minors give the four determinant factors and class-size double counting gives 96,36,72,72 unordered pairs. A standalone checker reconstructed the quaternions and kernel independently, verified the exact 24x24 integer characteristic polynomial and rational inverse, checked all 276 pairs, and directly computed 22x22 integer determinants for each class. No numerical enumeration is used as an infinite proof.

originality.rationale: Searched equivalent descriptions, broader and tabulated coverage in a semantic mathematical results database and relevant primary original papers. Weeks (2005) determines invariant eigenmodes of the quotient, Evans--Pugh (2009) provides McKay/character methods, and Hirao--Nozaki--Tasaka (2025) treats design strengths. They do not provide the exact 24-point degree-12 two-erasure determinant census, its 96 D-optimal relative 3-cycle pairs, or four exact values. Classical underlying group character and Jacobi identities are explicitly excluded from the novelty claim. Bounded-search originality uncertainty is recorded.

value.rationale: Selecting sites to keep under exactly two sensor losses is a natural D-optimal robust spherical harmonic interpolation problem: a single erasure is group-symmetry equivalent, whereas pair erasures first distinguish geometry. The theorem completely and exactly resolves all 276 distinct retained 22-site designs at a naturally maximal antipodal 24-site binary-octahedral configuration, including a strict optimizer class, all 96 equality cases, every determinant and a clean quotient-group geometric criterion. The improvement ratio is modest and is not invoked as evidence of large practical gain; the relevant value is the canonical complete optimization and its geometry. No broader theorem is claimed.
